comparison.objective: Clip a spring-hinged fingertip pulse oximeter fully onto a manikin’s index finger while steadying the hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze and hold a spring clip open, slide it over a close-fitting finger, stabilize the hand, then release the clip to clamp.
comparison.success_condition: Oximeter is on the correct finger, seated near its stop, display-up, released and still, while the hand remains near its original pose.
comparison.reason: Tests spring-clip opening, close-clearance placement, and patient-hand stabilization rather than impact fracture and loose-fragment containment.
